title: Use precise tracking to clean readable corrections first
summary: Snake Track-style precise tracking is valuable because it keeps readable acceleration and deceleration in the task, forcing the player to stabilize contact and pacing before speed becomes the focus.
why: Readable long strafes make it obvious when the player is still rushing corrections instead of matching target behavior cleanly.
Precise tracking builds contact quality that carries into both control and reactive work later.
actions: Match the target's pace through the readable strafe before trying to make the correction snappier.
Treat each direction change as a chance to land a clean stable response, not a chance to prove max speed.
If contact quality collapses whenever pace rises, stay at the speed where the majority of corrections still connect.
avoid: Do not turn precise tracking into a reactive panic test.

drills.reason: Snake Track keeps acceleration and deceleration readable, which is ideal for building correction quality.

evidence.claim: Snake Track-style precise tracking uses readable long strafes with acceleration and deceleration to train controlled contact instead of autopilot centering.
